svg.title: Hiring a ready-made AI employee
svg.desc: 1. The owner opens a package in the marketplace and answers its interview questions; answers that look like credentials are rejected. 2. Checks without side effects run first: free agent slots, admin capability policy and any products the package needs. 3. For a paid package, a one-time transaction and the hire record are written in one database transaction, then the Midtrans payment opens. 4. After payment, a step installer renders the persona, creates the agent in the container, installs skills and tools, stores the persona copy in PostgreSQL and pushes the policy layers. 5. Each step can resume; a worker retries failed installs.
